name: The Boyar's Petition
summary: Boyar Vintila Crainic has waited two hundred and six years in Castle Ravenloft to present a petition about a boundary stone. It needs the household's four seals.

stages.journal: Boyar Crainic's petition needs the four seals of the household before it can be presented: the valet's, the secretary's, the verger's and the lamplighter's. Each will lend theirs for one small thing the wedding night stopped.
objectives: Get the seals of Ghenadie the Valet, Anghel Daskal, Nicodim the Verger and Vlaicu the Lamplighter
stages.hint: Ask the ghost servants of Castle Ravenloft for their seals: Ghenadie, Anghel Daskal, Nicodim and Vlaicu.

stages.journal: The petition has all four seals. It has to be received by the Steward in the dining hall of Castle Ravenloft.
objectives: Have the Steward receive the sealed petition
stages.hint: Take the sealed petition to the Steward in the dining hall of Castle Ravenloft.

stages.journal: The Steward has received the Boyar's petition. Tell the Boyar.
objectives: Tell Boyar Crainic he has been received
stages.hint: Tell Boyar Crainic, in the audience hall of Castle Ravenloft, that the Steward has received his petition.

stages.journal: Boyar Crainic has been received after two hundred and six years. His boundary stone is under Lake Zarovich, and he is entirely satisfied.
